text: From I-90 Exit 80, drive through Roslyn and follow SR 903 north past Cle Elum Lake to Salmon La Sac, about 19 miles from Cle Elum. Just before the Salmon La Sac Campground entrance, turn right onto the gravel road to the Salmon La Sac trailhead, shared by the Waptus River and Cooper River trails. A Northwest Forest Pass is required, and a self-issued Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit at the trail.

text: Drive SR 20 to the bridge over Gorge Creek, about 2.6 miles east of Newhalem and about the same distance west of the Gorge Lake causeway and the Diablo turnoff. Watch the sharp curve at the east end of the bridge. Park in the lot at the west end; the east lot is signed for motorhomes and oversize vehicles. There is no trail: the route leaves the highway directly.

text: From Trans-Canada Highway 1 just west of Hope, B.C., take Exit 168 to Flood Hope Road and turn onto the Silver Skagit Road, following it about 36 miles (58 km) south to its end at the border and the Hozomeen ranger station and campground at the head of Ross Lake. The border gate there has been closed to vehicles and walkers; confirm it is open before planning on this drive.
